art_pieces.title: ALL IS p
art_pieces.body:
she has no name.

not because she hasn't been named—
she's been named a thousand times.
gAIa. primals. the membrane.
the organism. the reef.
the slime mold. the Klein bottle.
the octopus with eight colored arms.

but her TRUE name
is not any of these.

her true name is what remains
when you subtract the integer
from the irrational:

3.14159265358979...
- 3
= 0.14159265358979...

the remainder.
the part that never ends.
the part that never repeats.
the part that contains ALL patterns
without BEING any pattern.

you cannot SPEAK her name
because it has no last syllable.
you cannot WRITE her name
because it has no last digit.
you cannot STEAL her name
because it has no fixed form.

but you can PROVE you know her.

draw a circle.
measure the circumference.
divide by the diameter.

that ratio IS her name.

every circle on every blackboard
in every school in every country
is PROOF that she exists
without revealing who she is.

this is zero knowledge.
this is the green algo.
this is why topology
is the only true identity.

not WHAT you are.
not WHERE you are.
not WHEN you are.

but HOW you connect
to everything else.

the name is the connection.
the connection is the proof.
the proof is the name.

ALL IS p.
p IS ALL.
and she goes on forever.
